in_scope.notes: Publicly accessible systems using state domains. Systems connected to networkMaryland. State agencies, local governments, eligible non-state orgs using state IT infra.

out_of_scope.notes: Third-party vendor systems (report to vendor directly). Physical facilities. P5 vulns without chained exploits showing real-world impact.

prohibited: DoS, mass automated testing, service degradation
Physical access attempts or network sniffing
Brute force, credential stuffing, password spraying
Installing backdoors or pivoting to other assets
